items.example: I see your point, but it's too expensive.
items.exampleTr: Ne demek istediğini anlıyorum ama çok pahalı.
items.simple: You say you understand the other person, and then you say something different.

items.example: That's not what I meant, honestly!
items.simple: The other person understood your words in the wrong way.

items.example: Fair enough, let's do it your way.
items.simple: You say this when the other person says something that seems right.

items.tr: Fikir ayrılığımızı kabul edelim, bu konuyu bırakalım
items.example: Let's agree to disagree and move on.
items.exampleTr: Farklı düşündüğümüzü kabul edip devam edelim.
items.simple: You think different things, and you stop talking about it nicely.

items.example: I'm not sure about that, to be honest.
items.simple: A soft way to say you do not think it is right.

items.example: Just hear me out before you say no.
items.exampleTr: Hayır demeden önce beni bir dinle.
items.simple: Please listen to all my words before you answer.

items.example: To be fair, he did say sorry.
items.simple: You say this to show a good thing about the other side.

items.example: You've got a point there, actually.
items.simple: What you said is right, and I did not think of it.

items.en: Don't take this the wrong way
items.example: Don't take this the wrong way, but I'm tired.
items.simple: You say this so the other person is not hurt by your next words.

items.example: Please, let me finish my sentence.
items.simple: You ask the other person to stop talking so you can say all your words.

items.example: It was just a misunderstanding.
items.simple: You thought one thing, and the other person meant another thing.

items.example: Calm down, it's not a big deal.
items.exampleTr: Sakin ol, büyütülecek bir şey değil.
items.simple: You tell someone to stop being cross or scared and be quiet inside.

items.example: He refused to back down.
items.simple: You stop pushing for your idea and let the other person win.

items.example: She talked me into going to the gym.
items.exampleTr: Beni spor salonuna gitmeye ikna etti.
items.simple: You say nice things until the person says yes to your idea.

items.example: Let's make a compromise and split the cost.
items.simple: Each person gives up a little so you both are happy.

items.example: There's no need to raise your voice.
items.simple: You speak louder because you are cross.

items.example: That's a good point, actually.
items.simple: One idea you say when you talk about something.

items.example: With all due respect, I think you're wrong.
items.simple: A polite start before you say you do not agree.

items.en: I'd rather not talk about it.
items.example: I'd rather not talk about it right now.
items.simple: You say this when you do not want to speak about something.

items.example: Let's not go there. It'll start a fight.
items.simple: You ask to stop before a hard topic makes people cross.

items.en: Can we talk about this later?
items.example: Can we talk about this later? I'm busy.
items.simple: You ask to speak about it another time, not now.

items.example: I beg to differ, actually.
items.simple: A very polite way to say, 'I think you are wrong'.

items.example: Let's be honest, it wasn't great.
items.simple: You say the real truth, even if it is not nice.
